Seems like pointer to a deleted `Node` (scene before it was closed) is retained in the `SceneTreeEditor`, and accessed when trying to open popup.

> Reproducible in 4.8 dev2, first version reproducible is 4.6 beta1.

This issue was likely introduced by this [commit](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113789/changes#diff-84ab0b0439f6c6c10d6db31ee38ddec33dff74b5605a13fb2df03d89e47e9af9R929-R932). The operation to clear the mark was introduced to fix the same problem (#100812), but the visibility check was moved forward, preventing the mark from being cleared. When the connection dialog popup up, the previous cache might still be retained.
